title: Divisibility and Real Rank Zero
summary: Let $A$ be a simple separable exact $C^*$-algebra that has traces. We show the following existed regularity properties are equivalent: \quad(1) $l^\infty(A)/J_A$ has real rank zero, where $J_A$ is the trace kernel ideal. \quad(2) $A$ is tracially almost divisible. \quad(3) $A$ is tracially $m$-almost divisible for some $m\in\N\cup\{0\}.$ \quad(4) $A$ has tracial approximate oscillation zero. \quad(5) $A$ has Property (TM).
